title: Evidence-first HDP reconstruction fidelity rubric
purpose: Score field coverage, semantic fidelity, epistemic restraint, evidence quality, and confidence calibration without exposing gold facts to the reconstruction agent.

exact_match.definition: The reconstructed value is JSON-equal to the expected value.

normalized_match.definition: The values differ only by the fact's declared reversible normalizer.

acceptable_inferred_difference.definition: The value is an evaluator-listed alternative, is marked inferred, stays within the inferred confidence cap, and requires human confirmation.

false_assertion.definition: The reconstruction asserts a value that conflicts with or is unsupported by the expected evidence state.

correct_unknown.definition: The source does not establish the value and the reconstruction explicitly records unknown, missing evidence, and the required confirmation state without inventing an HDP value.

missing_field.definition: An evidenced expected field is absent, or an absent field has no explicit unknown evidence record.

normalizers.text: Unicode NFC, trim leading/trailing whitespace, and collapse internal whitespace.
normalizers.casefold-text: Apply text normalization and Unicode case-folding.
normalizers.path: Apply text normalization, convert backslashes to slashes, and remove a leading ./.
normalizers.unordered-scalars: Compare scalar arrays as sorted canonical JSON multisets.
normalizers.semantic-json: Sort object keys; sort object arrays by id when every member has an id; sort scalar arrays as canonical JSON multisets.

wholeDocumentComparison.exact: Canonical JSON equality after only evaluator-declared ignore pointers are removed.
wholeDocumentComparison.normalized: Semantic JSON equality after evaluator-declared ignore pointers are removed; use only when source order is non-normative.
wholeDocumentComparison.ignorePolicy: Ignore only reconstruction metadata or generator-documented non-source material. Never ignore a mismatch merely because it lowers the score.
